nodes.statement: Bounded position, integrity and speed must limit movement and inhibit/brake on invalid inputs.
Departure requires isolation, physical connector clearance, locked doors, usable authority and energy.

Both logical channels must agree to permit; loss/disagreement/replay/feedback failure actually injected while moving must latch zero torque/emergency within one 50 ms virtual step; retained protection and stopped authorised recovery only.
Recovery, maintenance, train division and rescue require qualified proving and privileged local procedure; no dashboard bypass.
Conflicting resources retain ownership through expiry, partition and restart; no conflicting occupancy.
